LanguageData.THR.Difficulty.T0.Desc: Goes through the motions. Lands close by accident.
LanguageData.THR.Difficulty.T1.Desc: Misses often, but the direction is right.
LanguageData.THR.Tut.Score.Near: Closer than theirs and still in range: {0} point each
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HS.P1.Title: 1. Horseshoes
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HS.P1.Body:
You pitch a horseshoe at a pin driven into the ground.
You are looking down at the target. The pin is dead centre. Inside the tight circle is a ringer; inside the wide one still scores. Past that, nothing.
Each inning both sides throw twice, alternating.
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HS.P2.Title: 2. Throwing
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HS.P2.Body:
Stop two bars in turn and the shoe goes.
Aim first, then power. The closer you stop to the green band, the truer the throw. Click or press Enter.
Higher tiers move the bars faster and throw better against you.
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HS.P3.Title: 3. Scoring
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HS.P3.Body:
A ringer scores on its own.
Everything else is counted after the inning. Only shoes closer than their nearest one count, so one inning goes entirely to one side.
There is no undo. A throw is a throw.
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HP.P1.Title: 1. Hoopstone
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HP.P1.Body:
You toss a stone through a standing ring.
You are looking down at the target. The ring is dead centre. Inside the tight circle goes clean through; the wider one is a stone that caught the rim.
Each inning both sides throw three times, alternating.
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HP.P2.Title: 2. Throwing
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HP.P2.Body:
Stop two bars in turn and the stone goes.
Aim first, then power. The closer you stop to the green band, the truer the throw. Click or press Enter.
Higher tiers move the bars faster and throw better against you.
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HP.P3.Title: 3. Scoring
LanguageData.THR.Tut.HP.P3.Body:
Unlike horseshoes, every throw scores on its own. You are not competing with them, you are competing with the ring.
In exchange the ring is a tighter target than the pin and the game is shorter. Three bad throws hands it over.
There is no undo.
